config.title: RISK CONFIGURATION
config.subtitle: Configure the risk-score thresholds used to classify LOW / MODERATE / HIGH

thresholds.title: Risk Score Thresholds
thresholds.lowMaxHint: Risk scores below this value are classified LOW.
thresholds.moderateMaxHint: Risk scores below this value (and at or above the LOW boundary) are classified MODERATE. Scores at or above it are classified HIGH.

validation.lowMaxRange: The LOW boundary must be greater than 0 and less than 100.
validation.moderateMaxRange: The MODERATE boundary must be greater than 0 and at most 100.
validation.order: The LOW boundary must be less than the MODERATE boundary.

explainer.title: How this affects predictions
explainer.body: New risk analyses run through /admin's risk pipeline are classified using these thresholds. This does not change the underlying AI prediction model or recalculate past analyses — only how new risk scores are labeled going forward.
explainer.note: The AI assistant's own conversational risk descriptions are generated by a separate service and are not affected by this configuration.
